verdict.rationale: Glama is an MCP registry, hosting, gateway and chat platform, so offering official SDKs is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions any Glama-published SDK, though: mcp-proxy is a tunneling utility for the inspector, and the npm/PyPI references describe users' own server packages, not Glama client libraries. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no documented spec to build or generate SDKs from.
